articles.title: Cache made consistent
articles.read_scope: Entire substantive body: definition through future work, including failure schedules and error-handler example.

practice.trigger: An invalidation cache must satisfy a declared convergence window.
practice.failure: Delayed fills, lost ordering metadata, or mismatched payload/revision leave stale values.
practice.mechanism: Measure client-visible version invariants at named timescales; trace transitions around mutations.
practice.conditions: Sampling and authority checks need a load budget; distinguish lag from persistence after invalidation.
practice.counterexample: A high hit rate or successful invalidation delivery does not establish correct reads.
practice.verification: Force fill/invalidate/evict and payload-version interleavings; test transient error handling.

articles.limitations: Operational evidence from TAO; not a portable linearizability proof or a recommendation to copy its scale.

articles.title: Lessons learned from 2+ years of nightly Jepsen tests
articles.read_scope: Entire substantive body: test setup, failed hypotheses, incident history, fix and lessons.

practice.trigger: Fault tests include lost responses, leader changes or uncertain commits.
practice.failure: A checker treats uncertain writes as definite aborts or misses an observable side-effect leak.
practice.mechanism: Retain unknown outcomes in histories; compare permitted executions with observed reads and commit evidence.
practice.conditions: Checker semantics and workload sensitivity must match the actual contract.
practice.counterexample: Repeated stress-test passes or a correlated fault injector do not prove correctness or root cause.
practice.verification: Inject acknowledgement loss and competing reads; retain logs and minimize the failing history.

articles.limitations: Historical bug fixed in CockroachDB 2.1.1/2.0.7; not a claim about a current vulnerability.

articles.title: How PlanetScale makes schema changes
articles.read_scope: Entire body including schema/code timing, pull-request automation, migration queue and limitations implicit in application coordination.

practice.trigger: Schema and application versions overlap during rollout.
practice.failure: DDL completion is confused with application compatibility.
practice.mechanism: Review schema and code together but sequence rollout independently; retain compatible readers and writers.
practice.conditions: Inspect actual migration algorithm, locks, data shape and old worker lifetime.
practice.counterexample: An online migration tool cannot make a removed column safe for old code.
practice.verification: Run old/new application versions against each supported migration stage, including rollback and concurrent queued changes.

articles.limitations: Rails/MySQL/Vitess operating account; categorical safety wording is not adopted as a guarantee.

articles.title: Introducing external backups on ClickHouse Cloud
articles.read_scope: Entire body including permissions, lifecycle, full/incremental tradeoff and restore into a new service; images not used as unique evidence.

practice.trigger: Recovery depends on backups in separately owned storage.
practice.failure: Backup objects exist but replacement identity, location or dependency access prevents restore.
practice.mechanism: Exercise restore into a new service using the actual target permissions and backup location.
practice.conditions: Inventory chain dependencies, retention ownership and recovery resource limits.
practice.counterexample: A successful export does not demonstrate usable restored data.
practice.verification: Deny old-service identity, locate a retained backup, restore independently, then validate expected application state.

articles.limitations: 2025 launch behavior; schedule/retention details differ in current docs and are not preserved as current defaults.
